title: Blue mushroom
content:
# Blue mushroom

Type: Food | Internal ID: MushroomBlue | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 20 | Max Stamina: 20 | Duration: 10m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Blue mushroom is an unimplemented item.

## Availability

The blue mushroom is currently unimplemented, and can only be obtained via console commands.

## Usage

As of version 0.147.3 of the game, it has no use and can only be eaten raw.

Categorias: Unfinished, Food
